summary: Both phases delivered exactly what the plan specified. Phase-01 removed the unsupported --target flag from buildVibeArgs and added the two regression assertions the plan required. Phase-02 wired the review-code worklist from global-file-reconciliation.json via a new pure domain helper, removed the dead reconciliationMd input, and covered the populated, absent, and malformed JSON cases with integration tests. No unplanned files were touched, no excluded scope was entered, and both commit subjects match the plan verbatim.
